title: Support · Mobile · inbox

draftReply.regions: approve-and-send · destination of draftReply; agent-drafted editable body, tone, Redo / Approve & send

shape.avatarTint: enum: pink | green | violet | neutral  → data-mod="is-:email.avatarTint" on .ava
shape.subject: string

shape.label: string (UPPERCASE, e.g. REAL, DRAFT READY, DECISION)
shape.kind: enum: live | blocked | done | ready  → data-mod="is-:tag.kind" on .astat

watching.note: same email shape as needsYou; rows render dimmed (.erow.is-muted) with an envelope avatar; typically no tags

draft.note: Draft-reply screen (support-draft) — the agent's drafted reply, awaiting your approval
draft.avatarTint: enum: pink | green | violet | neutral → is-:draft.avatarTint on .ava
draft.subject: string (the thread being replied to)

actions.name: openThread
actions.does: open the email-thread view for this ask

actions.name: draftReply
actions.does: open the Draft-reply screen (support-draft) with the agent's draft

actions.name: browseWatching
actions.does: show the watching list when caught up

shared: wired/_base/states.html  (empty / loading / error — label once, reused everywhere)
rules: every data-mod is is-:path — engine toggles is-<value> on a base class whose CSS owns the look; no inline color default.
Only real people reach Support; no spam / no-reply / automated mail.
Mail asking for your presence or a decision is flagged → needs-you (Catch Up).
Never compose raw email here; the agent drafts and acts on approval.
Names like Dana, Priya, Marco and company names are sample data.
